CANNOT_CHANGE_OWN_ROLE: You can't change your own role. Ask another organizer.
CANNOT_REMOVE_SELF: You can't remove yourself. Leave the event instead.
COVER_CHANGED_CONCURRENTLY: Another organizer changed the cover at the same time. Please try again.
EVENT_HAS_OPEN_REPORTS: This event has reports waiting for a decision, so it can't be deleted yet.
EVENT_SUSPENDED: This event was suspended for breaking our terms, so it can't be changed or joined.
EVENT_UNDER_REVIEW: This event is on hold while Everglow reviews it. No one can join or add photos until then.
LAST_ORGANIZER: Every event needs an organizer. Make someone else an organizer first.
ORGANIZER_BLOCKED_BY_CALLER: You blocked the organizer of this event. Unblock them to join.
REMOVED_FROM_EVENT: An organizer removed you from this event. Only an organizer can let you back in.
TARGET_NOT_A_MEMBER: That person isn't in this event anymore.
